title: Yunikorn k8shim: Nickname profile can panic with an out-of-bounds slice error when transforming crafted input into a…
description: A security vulnerability in the yunikorn-k8shim package allows the Nickname profile to panic due to an out-of-bounds slice error when processing crafted input into a short destination buffer. This can cause a denial of service by crashing the affected component. The issue affects versions prior to 1.9.0-r1 and has been assigned CVE-2026-56851 with a high severity rating.
